scope: Compiled Svelte and real Chromium; native-host and provider doubles. No native runtime or real external client/tool execution.

tests.name: Default shelf shows only registered providers and never duplicates tab controls
Sidebar collapse fills the native surface and persists independently of the inspector
Closing and reopening a website leaves one saved provider and one browser tab
Provider settings open on demand without a second provider list or advanced controls
Ordinary browsing never creates a registered sidebar provider in the fixture flow
Registry activity rings track real state fields, reduced motion and disabled exposure
Client setup initially exposes only client, model and one private-launch action
Private launch starts then probes then copies; no config overwrite or false client-connected claim
Failed gateway probe does not retrieve or copy a key
Clipboard failure is actionable and never renders the local key
Navigating away cancels late credential retrieval and clipboard side effects
Losing model exposure while connecting prevents a stale launch command
Tool library and technical task settings are opt-in; browsing recipes never installs code
Folder picker fills one quoted argument; saving a recipe still requires separate process consent
Cancelling the native folder dialog preserves the typed folder without effects
Simple file recipe refuses a filesystem-root share or parent traversal
Tool catalogs are collapsed and searchable; clearing a filter restores choices
Task options validate budgets and forward automatic result continuation to Zag
Active tasks replace configuration panels with the relevant approval and stop controls
Budget pause resumes the same run without starting over or replaying an approval
Non-resumable state cannot be forced through UI; cancellation remains available
Routine task progress is quiet; a safe pause still surfaces attention while browsing
Current MCP progress is visible as untrusted text without granting execution
Clean connection, library and browser layouts remain bounded at three window sizes
